periods.label: 体弱多病的一年一班导师
titles: 破军学园一年一班级任导师

appearance.overview: Young female teacher with cheerful presentation despite severe frailty.

voice_quality.tone: bright, cutesy, then weak when coughing

distinctive: asks students to call her 小有里

personality.summary: Kind and enthusiastic to the point of exhausting herself for students.
desires: see students attempt the selection battles
personality.inner_conflict: Wants to cheer students up despite a body that cannot keep up.

quote_samples: 老师希望各位尽可能地参加，并且尝试朝着这个目标前进。

habits.daily_routine: Teaches homeroom and sometimes commentates matches.
quirks: claims daily blood vomiting is normal

formative_events: Served as examiner for Ikki's entrance evaluation
background.pre_story: Recognized Ikki's qualities enough for him to enter Hagun.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former entrance examiner and current homeroom teacher; he respects her kindness.

knowledge: Blazer mechanics such as ultra-pure water insulation
periods.summary: Yuri introduces herself as class 1's homeroom teacher, explains the new real-combat selection battle system, encourages everyone to participate, and collapses from overexcitement. Later she commentates Shizuku's battle and explains ultra-pure water while again coughing blood.

key_events.summary: Explains that all students may enter real selection battles for Seven Stars representation.
Explains Shizuku's ultra-pure water defense during commentary.

periods.label: 小有里与犯规默许
titles: 破军学园一年一班级任导师

status.health: habitual blood coughing/nosebleeds; brings blood for commentary

personality.summary: Sickly and comic in presentation, but fair-minded enough to understand Ikki's knightly request.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former entrance examiner and homeroom teacher; trusts his word about Ayase's cheating.
relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Allows the match to continue at Ikki's request so Ayase can be helped rather than merely disqualified.

periods.summary: Oreki appears as commentary and supervision staff during selection battles. Before Ikki's match with Ayase, Ikki reports Ayase's rooftop trap and possible arena cheating. Oreki would normally stop the match, but Ikki asks her to let it continue so he can verify and save Ayase's true self. She accepts, watches Ayase's illegal Reppu Soukon traps, and entrusts the situation to Ikki.

key_events.summary: Agrees not to immediately call Ayase's foul because Ikki wants to save her dignity.

periods.time: Ikki's confined selection match and final day
periods.label: 折木老师的担忧

status.current: recognizes Ikki's condition as dangerous and supports him

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Teacher who witnesses his eighteenth win and worries his illness is more than a cold.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Reports Ikki's condition to her but withholds the worst details to avoid panic.

periods.summary: Oreki accompanies Ikki's eighteenth selection match at the League facility as the school-side teacher and sees that he is coughing, pale, and seriously unwell despite winning. Because she is familiar with illness, she suspects the condition is not a simple cold, but does not fully alarm Shizuku and Alice. On the final day she joins the students encouraging Ikki at the gate.

key_events.summary: Observes Ikki win while showing dangerous symptoms.

periods.time: Ikki's Hagun entrance exam and one year later classroom opening
periods.label: 死亡宣告的入学试验

status.health: chronically ill and prone to coughing blood
status.role: examiner who admitted Ikki after losing to him

personality.summary: Gentle and self-sacrificing as a teacher, yet ruthless in battle when protecting a student's future.
values: students' futures matter more than pride

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Exam candidate and later student; she respects him but warns that his knight path may destroy him.
relationships.hagun-examinees-vol08: Other examinees accidentally caught in Violet Pain during Ikki's exam.

periods.summary: Yuri's vol-08 focus comes in Episode0. One year before vol-01 she serves as an entrance-exam examiner. After Ikki helps her when she collapses, he challenges her directly, identifying her as the strongest person present. She accepts, first testing him with Violet Pain, then engaging him as a teacher determined to stop him from walking a self-destructive path. She loses when Ikki copies and evolves her swordsmanship, withstands shared injuries, uses Ittou Shura and disarms her with an adapted empty-hand technique. Though she admits him, she begs him to reconsider the knight path; a year later she tells him to prove her fears wrong with his weakest strength.

key_events.summary: Accepts Ikki's challenge, loses the entrance duel, admits him and warns him about his self-destructive path.
